reviewer: Independent Codex final acceptance reviewer; single agent; no implementation edits
decision_scope: Final M10 completion under Completion boundary and Task C, not a reopening of the accepted bounded M10-B implementation fixes.
rationale: Three dossiers exist and support useful local export mechanism evidence, but three qualified passing pilot dossiers are not established: the native zh-shuang corpus is absent and the preregistered sponsor/Human reviewer was replaced by the implementing agent. PASSED_WITH_DEVIATIONS is not sufficient to discharge those explicit completion requirements. Conditional local implementation acceptance remains supportable. The verdict is driven by material acceptance gaps, not Low findings or sandbox unavailability.

critical_high_status.qualification: This is a bounded evidence/acceptance review, not an exhaustive fresh source/security audit.

findings.scenario: The zh_shuang dossier reuses the English 9:16 final used by the vertical factual Short. A zh-Hans metadata member and locale-rule checks exercise packaging, but do not assess a native Chinese final or Chinese-language suitability. The dossier expressly says no zh-Hans final exists. Counting this as the required native zh-shuang passing pilot would declare M10 complete without its specified third corpus.
findings.fix: Supply an approved native zh-Hans/zh-shuang final and complete the cohort dossier against a frozen source head with the required qualified Human judgments, metrics, correction evidence and export checks. Preserve the English surrogate run as partial mechanism evidence. A scope amendment must be explicit and independently accepted if the sponsor instead elects to change the completion requirement; no such amendment to the native-cohort requirement is established here.

findings.scenario: All three dossiers record agent-performed profile publication, narrative review, disposition and package selection under sponsor chat delegation. This is disclosed authorized local execution according to the supplied provenance, not an allegation of unauthorized actions. Authorization to execute does not turn the agent into the preregistered sponsor as HUMAN_SHOWRUNNER or independently validate its narrative/utility judgments. Even the originally allowed single-reviewer independence limit presupposed a Human reviewer. B8 accepts local fixes while explicitly leaving these reviewer/corpus dimensions open.
findings.fix: Obtain and record actual sponsor/Human review of the frozen cohort evidence and assets, including narrative suitability, finding judgments, correction usefulness and package choices; perform/reconfirm any necessary custodian decisions through the qualified Human. Retain the agent records and delegated provenance. Do not relabel historical agent actions as Human actions or infer reviewer acceptance from the general instruction to do every step.

Targeted source reads verify export uses QualityProbeRuntime.launch with m10-export prefix. No confirmed new Production Authority mutation surface found in this bounded review.
no_network_no_production_write.runtime: Supplied network-experiment.json records AF_INET socket EPERM, seccomp/cgroup properties and cleanup inside one m10-export unit using the shared launcher. Not rerun by this reviewer.
no_network_no_production_write.qualification: Runtime assertion covers confined workers/probes only. Host code has static/source evidence, not runtime network isolation. This scan is direct, not transitive/dynamic proof of all possible imports or side effects. Router environment reads select governance directories; launcher allowlists manager environment; worker clears its environment. No credential-free assertion about the entire ArcReel host process.

determinism_amendment.evidence: Preregistration lines 151-158 and design section 7 explicitly retain the failed frozen archive comparison and replace it with same-selection archive equality plus cross-root content-member equality. Commit 7609bceac is the amendment; run 2 is recorded at that code head.
determinism_amendment.judgment: Keeping per-root selection/disposition/candidate provenance in manifest.json is a coherent explanation of different whole ZIP digests, not evidence of nondeterminism for one immutable selection. The amended criterion can support local export implementation acceptance. It cannot retroactively establish the original frozen pass, and does not cure Human reviewer or native-corpus gaps. A later qualified pilot should explicitly freeze the amended rule before execution; no demand to remove provenance or rewrite source follows from this review.
